entities.name: Sign Pollution
entities.description: Issues related to visual pollution caused by excessive or improperly managed signage, including billboards and large advertisements, impacting city aesthetics and environment.

entities.name: Signage
entities.description: The design, placement, and regulation of signs used for commercial and public purposes within the city, including regulations on size, placement, and content.

entities.name: Commercial Real Estate
entities.description: Properties used for business purposes, including retail, office, and industrial spaces, with considerations for signage and visibility for commercial success.

entities.name: Urban Regulations
entities.description: Rules and policies established by the city to manage urban development, signage, zoning, and other aspects of city planning and maintenance.
